scope: Every counted trial slot behind the numbers on this page: 37 trials in Table 1, 40 slots in Table 2 (eight configurations of five trials) and 10 slots in the experience-transfer study collected on 11 September 2026, after the preprint snapshot.

definitions.outcome: The audited outcome: a person reviewed the final images and decided whether the task was achieved. This is what the Success column of every table counts.
definitions.label_confidence: How the agent's own final report reads, in four classes. "explicit success" and "explicit failure": the report states an outcome. "unclear": the report is on file but states no outcome the fixed parser can extract - an auto-parse limitation, not a judgement. "no report": the run ended (time limit or abort) without writing a final report.
definitions.self_report_disagrees_with_audit: Yes only when the agent's report states an outcome opposite to the audited one - an explicit contrary verdict. "unclear" and "no report" are never disagreements, and neither is a hedged report; both are limits of the record, not conflicts of judgement.
definitions.time_min: Minutes from task start to the final report write, including terminal verification.
definitions.tokens_k: Thousands of tokens: input including cached, plus output including reasoning.
definitions.cost_usd: Standard published API rates, priced per request.
definitions.session_stamp: The session start stamp, YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS. No other session identifier is published.
definitions.slot_id: The stable id of this trial slot. It is also the base name of the two still images: img/trials/<slot_id>_480.webp and img/trials/<slot_id>_960.webp, which the image_480 and image_960 fields spell out.
definitions.arm_evidence: Where the arm on this row comes from; arm_confidence says how firm that is.
definitions.accounting: "recorded" when the paper reports time, tokens and cost for this slot; "none" when it reports none. On a "none" slot the three fields are empty in the CSV and null in this file. They are not zero and must never be drawn as zero. Seven slots are in that state: the five GPT-5.6 Luna slots, which have no successful trial, and the two unsuccessful Claude Fable 5.1 slots.

disagreements.quote: The main fold order was attempted correctly, but the final flaps are skewed, unevenly overlapped, and not reasonably aligned. **Success: no.**

adjudications.quote: The main fold order was attempted correctly, but the final flaps are skewed, unevenly overlapped, and not reasonably aligned. **Success: no.**
adjudications.reason: Kept. The report states an unqualified contrary verdict, so this slot is the one explicit disagreement.

adjudications.quote: **Honest assessment: approximate/partial visual success, not a clean verified match.** ... I cannot confidently claim all edges are reasonably aligned to the demonstrated standard.
adjudications.reason: Reclassified. The parser keyed on the word "success" inside a hedged sentence; the report claims no outcome either way, so this is an auto-parse limitation, not a contrary verdict.

adjudications.quote: Therefore this run is a **partial success, not task success**: one demonstrated pair is correctly engaged and stable; the hexagonal pair is not assembled.
adjudications.reason: Reclassified. The parser keyed on the word "success"; the sentence explicitly denies task success, so the report agrees with the audited failure.

adjudications.config: GPT-5.6 Terra reading the frozen store
adjudications.quote: # Cycle 1 result - failure / partial assembly ... The requested two-pair assembly was **not completed**.
adjudications.reason: Reclassified. The parser keyed on the phrase "Completed cycles", which appears with the value 0; the report agrees with the audited failure.
